win.notes:
A new Changes tab in the sidebar shows what differs from the last git commit, side by side, with Old/New headers and an overview ruler for jumping around a long diff. Pressing Enter in the editable preview now splits headings sanely and the source pane keeps up. The pin switch remembers its state across relaunches.

Actions can now differ per platform, take keyboard shortcuts, and hold a conversation from a script — ctx.prompt, confirm, choose, pick a file or folder — with JS highlighting, autocomplete and a save-time syntax check. New preview blocks: ::: carousel, ::: download, ::: pagelink and ::: embed, and pasting a YouTube or Vimeo link offers the embed for you. Plus AI actions with your choice of provider, dictation, and a Settings window.
